samples.text:
**Yes.**

A tuna melt consists of fillings (tuna salad and cheese) between bread (typically toasted on the outside), which fits the standard definition of a sandwich—even though one side is often open-faced before broiling, most versions use two slices of bread and qualify as a sandwich.
